info.title: Aware Care API
info.description: Product master v2.0 operation inventory. Handoff 1.0.0 strict wire-detail draft, subject to recorded decisions in spec/api/README.md. No API implementation or approval is asserted.

servers.description: Same-origin application API. Nano loopback backend uses port 8000; ZRT is separate.

post.description: Origin checked even before a session exists. Always issues a new session token: with a valid session of the same role already present, its actor continues under a rotated session (new ID, token and CSRF token; the old session is revoked), so a planted token never reads what is entered after consent (#434). Guest creation rejects any client-supplied identity or role as an unknown field. Saved mode requires upstream identity. Adult ineligibility routes to limits and never authorizes health writes. Idempotency requires a server-issued pre-session browser nonce to scope creation before actor allocation; transport detail remains draft.

Cache-Control.description: no-store for all session, health, job, settings and presenter responses.

Set-Cookie.description: Opaque session and CSRF cookie. HTTPS deployment uses Secure; session is HttpOnly and SameSite. X-CSRF-Token response header supplies token to client.

X-CSRF-Token.description: CSRF token bound to the new session.

post.description: Presenter only. With reset=true, return success only after prior fixture cleanup completes; with reset=false (#316) add the case to this presenter's live demo patient (a new one when none is live). Keep presenter identity distinct from synthetic guest. If cleanup is pending or fails, return 409 RESET_PENDING or 503 RESET_FAILED rather than starting another guest. The response names the case state and the patient-site next_path (#315). prepare=result (#316) readies a quick demo in a presenter-owned scenario_prepare job (prepare_job_id, read with getJob): the reviewed questions with the scenario's synthetic answers, guidance through the same checks as a patient (local mode fails closed; no scripted substitute) and, for a doctor result, the provider search. urgency_input=written (#358) gives the case only the written concern (checklist: none apply), so createCase's red-flag screen of the concern decides at creation (local mode: the device's model); a screen that cannot run returns 503 RED_FLAG_SCREEN_UNAVAILABLE and creates nothing. Retry with the same idempotency key.

sessionCookie.name: awarecare_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite cookie. Secure in trusted-network HTTPS deployment. Development loopback policy must be explicitly configured.

ProfileItem.title: ProfileItem
ProfileItem.description: Null confirmation means not current; new-case confirmation remains required even for previously confirmed profile entries.

ProfileWrite.title: ProfileWrite
ProfileWrite.description: expected_revision=0 creates an absent profile. Confirmation timestamps supplied by clients are not authoritative; server records the actual confirmation event. Saving requires saved mode and an explicit action.

ConfirmedContextWrite.title: ConfirmedContextWrite
ConfirmedContextWrite.description: No document-origin or arbitrary Fact IDs accepted here. Server checks source profile ownership/revision and records confirmation. Null value remains unknown, not a negative finding.

concern.description: Empty only for a case routed to urgent help from a ticked reviewed warning sign with no concern written (#392, R15).

urgent_level.description: #153 (ADR-003 amendment 3): the reviewed level of the red flag that routed the case to urgent help, from a ticked checklist item or from the red-flag screen of the person's words. Null when the case is not urgent or was routed otherwise (for example a scripted mock scenario).

found_doctors.description: #356 (additive): the first eligible matches (at most 3) of the case's current doctor search, for the visit summary (A12 and its PDF). Present only with current routine guidance and a current search at this revision that found an eligible doctor. Fictional synthetic-directory doctors; only facts A10 shows.

concern.description: #392 (R15): required (at least one visible character after trimming) unless the red_flags checklist answer ticks a reviewed warning sign; the case then goes to urgent help at once and a concern that was not written is stored empty.

earlier_questions.description: #357 (CHG-DEV-API-005): the case's earlier issued questions (slot below the current one, not invalidated) with their current answers, in slot order, for a previous-question step. Read fresh on every response.

FactCorrection.title: FactCorrection
FactCorrection.description: User correction is stored separately from original extraction text and source. Preserve unit provenance; never rewrite the original source.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Internal persistence object. storage_key is an opaque server-generated value, never a client path. page_count may be null before parsing.

DocumentPublic.title: DocumentPublic
DocumentPublic.description: Patient-facing projection; excludes internal storage_key. The original filename is display-only and excluded from logs.

Job.title: Job

error_detail.description: #538: content-free reasons a job failed, when known: per attempt, the validator rule and the place it fired, e.g. 2:prohibited_certainty/rules_out_risk@claims[1].text or 1:third_person@actions[0].rationale, or the typed result of an attempt without a draft (2:TIMEOUT). Rule codes and places only, never case or model text. A scenario_prepare job carries its guidance job's reasons.

error_reason.description: #550: a failed job's reason in plain words, built only from error_code and error_detail (never case or model text), e.g. "The first draft was rejected: a statement was judged to rule out a risk (a stated fact or explanation). Nothing was published." Null unless the job failed with a known reason.

stage.description: #548: the step a running scenario_prepare job is on, from real state only (the guidance job's status and the device's model calls since it started): preparing, queued, screening (red-flag screen), writing (the draft), rewriting (the one repair draft after a failed check), checking (the draft's checks and the certainty review), finishing (doctor search). Null for every other job and once a job has ended. Never a percentage, never content.

Job.description: A result ID conveys no authorization. There is no raw output field. result_type is an additive draft wire clarification of the master response convention. scenario_prepare (#316, CHG-DEV-API-002) is a presenter-owned quick-demo preparation; its case_id is null and its result_id is its own receipt.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: Schema validity alone never makes an item usable. Clinical support requires approved status, a named review record, current review dates and applicability.

validation_status.description: supported: backed by confirmed facts (case_fact) or cited approved evidence (clinical); suppressed: not shown as a finding; general_knowledge (ADR-015): a clinical possible explanation from the model's general medical knowledge, labelled as such, never citing a source; pending: not yet validated.

Guidance.title: Guidance
Guidance.description: Only validated publishable objects reach patient APIs. All clinical text, including prose fields, must map to reviewed support. A valid schema is insufficient for clinical validation.

PathwayRule.title: PathwayRule
PathwayRule.description: predicate_id resolves to an independently reviewed, versioned rule implementation. This is a reference, not executable user content.

Provider.title: Provider
Provider.description: All displayed attributes require attribute provenance, including nested locations. Array absence means unknown, not a confirmed negative. Synthetic labels are mandatory regardless of completeness.

ProviderLocationQuery.title: ProviderLocationQuery
ProviderLocationQuery.description: At least one resolvable stored location or city/region/postal combination is required by service validation. No symptoms or case IDs may be sent externally.

Export.title: Export
Export.description: Internal persistence contract. Bytes are only returned by authorized /exports/{export_id}/download.

TimingSummary.title: TimingSummary
TimingSummary.description: Unknown measurements are null. Zero samples cannot support performance claims; fabricated zero-duration measurements are invalid. CHG-DEV-API-007 (#428): in mock mode inference_ms is null, as no model runs.

RuntimeSnapshot.title: RuntimeSnapshot

demo.description: CHG-DEV-API-007 (#425, #426): the last presenter reset of this presenter's browser (its lineage: every presenter session it started; running or failed blocks a new demo) and the IDs of that lineage's synthetic demo cases a patient tab can still open (a demo actor with a live session). Content-free; never a patient guest's case or another presenter browser's.

RuntimeSnapshot.description: mode is a draft wire clarification. Device/model identifiers are null or unverified where not observed; never fabricate readiness. CHG-DEV-API-007 (#429): observed_at is when this response checked readiness and the queue; the device inventory carries the date it was recorded, and in local mode runtime_version and runtime_qualified_on come from the model manifest (its runtime record and last passed qualification); timings_latest_at is the newest timing sample's finish time. In mock mode timing_summary.inference_ms is null (no model runs; #428).

reset.description: true: first remove this presenter's earlier demo (the behaviour of earlier releases). false (#316): add the case to this presenter's live demo patient, so prepared demos coexist; a new demo patient is created when none is live. A pending or failed reset blocks either way.

prepare.description: start: the case starts at its gate (questions, urgent help or limits). result (#316): a presenter-owned scenario_prepare job answers the reviewed questions with the scenario's synthetic answers, confirms the review, runs guidance through the same services and checks as a patient (local mode: the live local model, fail-closed) and, for a doctor result, the provider search.

urgency_input.description: checklist: the scenario's own red-flag checklist answer (the behaviour of earlier releases). written (#358): the case gets only the scenario's written concern, with the checklist answered "none of these apply", as a patient who writes an emergency in their own words; the concern then takes createCase's red-flag screen (local mode: the device's model). A match routes the case to urgent help at creation; a screen that cannot run returns 503 RED_FLAG_SCREEN_UNAVAILABLE and creates nothing. Mock mode keeps the scenario's scripted outcome.

ScenarioLoaded.title: ScenarioLoaded

state.description: The case state when the load returned (#315). A case being prepared (prepare=result) is still intake here; its prepare job reports when the result is ready.

next_path.description: Patient-site path of the screen to open for this case (#315): questions, urgent help or limits by state; for prepare=result the result screen (guidance, or doctors with an A10 search preset).

prepare_job_id.description: #316: the presenter-owned scenario_prepare job (getJob) for prepare=result while the case needs questions and guidance; null otherwise (urgent and limited cases are already at their result). The job carries status and a content-free error code only, never case content.

ScenarioLoaded.description: Returned only after prior demo reset completes. Do not replace the presenter identity cookie with the guest identity. Session is a server-owned synthetic session descriptor. #315/#316 (CHG-DEV-API-002): state, next_path and prepare_job_id let the presenter open the patient screen directly and follow a quick-demo preparation without reading patient content.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Closed content-free schema. Optional fields formalize the master event table. Emit only fields relevant to that event. No arbitrary metadata, health content, names, filenames, prompts, model text, full query URLs or query values.

TelemetrySnapshot.title: TelemetrySnapshot
TelemetrySnapshot.description: W06 (ADR-017): public, content-free aggregates of local AI use on this device, the reviewed list prices and assumptions for the page's estimates, and the privacy facts. No case, actor, text or exact time.

metered.description: The per-consultation window (#398, ADR-017 amendment 5): `guided` and the usage beside it (AI calls, token counts, AI time and GPU energy) count the same whole hours [from, to): the outcome window up to now (#638, ADR-017 amendment 6), from the outcome counting start (#324) and from the first whole metered hour (#124) on. Per-consultation figures divide only these. `since` is when metering of the live totals began within the period (#124).

from.description: Start of the per-consultation window (a whole hour); equal to `to` when the window is empty.

to.description: End of the per-consultation window: consultations.counted_to (the end of the current hour, UTC).

ai_calls.description: Every AI call in [from, to), for every consultation and screen in those hours.

fail_closed_reasons.description: #538: why the fail-closed results stopped: the validator rule of each rejected attempt (e.g. prohibited_certainty/rules_out_risk, third_person), counted over the same hours as fail_closed; content-free, never a place or text. A count below suppressed_below is null.

counted_from.description: Start of the whole hours the outcome figures cover: the hour the period starts in (#638, ADR-017 amendment 6).

counted_to.description: End of those hours: the end of the current hour (UTC), so the outcome figures run up to now, including today (#638).

counting_since.description: When outcome counting started (#324): the later of counted_from and the hour of the first event that records the running mode, when the data directory also holds events written before the mode was recorded (never counted, ADR-017 amendment 3). Equal to counted_from otherwise.

consultations.description: Outcome figures over the period up to now, including the current hour (#638, ADR-017 amendment 6); breakdowns below suppressed_below are null.

counted_from.description: Start of the whole hours the usage totals count: the hour the period starts in (#432, #638).

counted_to.description: End of those hours: the end of the current hour (UTC). Usage totals (AI calls, tokens, AI time, call timings, output speed and energy) count up to now, including the current hour (#638, ADR-017 amendment 6).

by_task.description: Model calls by task over the same hours as the outcome figures (#638); concern_check is the #154 concern check (#271).

LogsSnapshot.title: LogsSnapshot

precision.description: hour: the source keeps the hour only (content-free events and model calls, #275, ADR-017).

reason.description: #550: a failed job's reason in plain words (Job.error_reason), built from its codes only.

next_before.description: #577: an opaque cursor; pass it as `before` to read the rows after this page (Load older). Null on the last page.

level_counts.description: #577: kept rows of each level that match the kind, search and since filters (not the level filter).

total.description: #577: kept rows that match every filter, on all pages.

LogsSnapshot.description: #548 getLogs: the presenter's debug Logs view (O01), newest first. Content-free: job IDs, kinds, statuses, typed codes, #538 rejection reasons, timings, model-call tasks and token counts, readiness and API error codes with route templates and request IDs. Never an actor, session or case ID, a token, a cookie, a message or any patient or model text. #577: level, kind and the text search filter every kept row on the server; pages follow next_before.
